Required documents (please provide what applies):
- W-9 (if Orion Bio, Inc. is a US taxpayer) OR W-8BEN-E (if non-US entity)

3) Payment terms: Net 30 (default) — if you need alternate terms, flag now and copy Lauren (Legal).
